text: Somebody always fronts the money,\Nthen spends a week chasing five people.
You write the rule.\NNothing in the code reads it.
It sets the split, the recipient, the deadline.
One decision. Ten real PayPal calls.
Then it sleeps.\NRoutine payments never wake it.
It chose who to chase,\Nand wrote the nudge itself.
The deadline is the deadline.\NNobody decides this but the agent.
It quotes the organizer back,\Nand checks the numbers against PayPal.
Three refunds, each exactly what that person paid.
The same amount out as came in.\NNothing left over.
“Refund everyone unless all five chip in.”\NA count, not an amount.
Four of five paid.\NThe agent gives it all back.
No if-statement could have done that.
